summary: Expanded research covers 72 creative fields with 582 repository queries and 18 model tasks, including new rendering-denoising, media-quality-analysis and print-prepress searches. This edition provides 52 detailed profiles (37 first additions, 14 completed earlier leads and one substantive update) plus two additional screened leads, adding 39 library entries. The localized SolidCraft derivative is explicitly distinguished from its existing upstream entry. Highlights include new local/browser/Android tools, fuller guides for earlier screened entries, and Audio Studio MCP 1.0’s substantive browser-UI update. Code licensing is reviewed separately from weights, services and assets. The weekly review covered all 1,197 entries present at the start of this run; today’s records also receive fresh six-check assessments. Quality gaps remain explicit, with no popularity-based promotion. No discovered tool was installed or run. All 582 repository queries were attempted: 293 succeeded, 198 failed and 91 were partial, with 89 bounded/truncated results. All 18 model-task queries completed. GitHub HTTP 403 failures and blocked Codeberg/SourceHut access leave coverage gaps; this is broad bounded research, not an exhaustive inventory.
